scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web,ocr,chroma,pdf -c blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run ai:ocr" "npm run ai:chroma" "npm run ai:pdf"
scripts.dev:web: cd web && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.build:web: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.setup:ai: python -m venv ai/ocr/.venv && ai/ocr/.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r ai/ocr/requirements.txt && ai/ocr/.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install flask chromadb numpy reportlab
scripts.db:init: cd server && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:init
